fact: Algeria's Ministry of Vocational Training and Education launched a national 12-week artificial intelligence training programme to develop advanced digital skills.

Le Chiffre d'Affaires reports that the national 7-77 digital inclusion programme, launched in July 2026 with Algerie Telecom taking part, had held 40 online sessions for 1,166 participants and began in-person sessions for 600 people at Setif on 9 August 2026, with Annaba and Saida scheduled next.
